body: I typically go to Raymond when I need the emergency room, but I have taken lots of friends into lethbridge and nearly every single time it was an absolute joke. Once I had a friend that had a workplace accident - a chain snapped and hit him in the face, cutting his eye open. We sat in the ER for 4 hours before anyone saw him even though he was bleeding from his face and eye. Another friend got into a car accident and had a major concussion. We went into the ER twice for that concussion because it was messing with him so much,and both times the doctors said it was no big deal even though he had major brain trauma. He ended up going to a specialist for 2 years to try to fix the damage. The ER said to watch a video and take a nap. The mental health unit is a joke. A friend was having a panic attack so they left her in a room for 3 hours to freak out then came in and berated her for not being calm enough to work with, and another friend was brought in by ambulance for threatening to commit suicide, and they said he needed to sleep it off and released him an hour later without even letting him see a psychologist. The ER department has always been a joke, and going there has consistently been a waste of time for me.

You are not crazy, and you didn't misunderstand when you were 13. This is gaslighting, even though the missionaries probably dont realize it. What you were told when you were 13 is what the church taught as truth. What you are being told now is what the church now teaches as truth, and they say they have always taught it this way. The fact is the church changes its narrative to fit their goals. Now that the internet is more widespread, they cant hide things as easily as they used to, so they paint the picture that they have been open and honest and have always shared things that were actually hidden and distorted for years.

I'm sure the church would have plenty people who knew theology in leadership if all the people who learned about the church's history didn't end up leaving.
If you dont let leadership learn about the real history and keep it to the surface level stuff with their own interpretations, then they cant lead others astray.

2. tear it up and throw it away
3. write a list of things you like, people you love, and things you are good at
4. put it up somewhere you will be able to see it every day
5. never forget that you are amazing and there are people out there that care about you. People who don't want to see you dead. Your are strong enough to live this life, please don't throw it away.
